cd /tmp/r2run-qp4spzw4/data/text; cat > $TMPDIR/a.py <<'E'
import re,glob,collections
n=0;c=collections.Counter();tot=0
for f in sorted(glob.glob('*.txt')):
    for p in re.split(r'=== page \d+',open(f).read()):
        if 'recommends the following' not in p: continue
        tot+=1
        m=re.search(r'recommends the following(.*?)(Abstentions|$)',p,re.S|re.I)
        rec=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',m.group(1))
        if re.search(r'ticket\s*escalation',p,re.I):
            n+=1
            # recommendation text only vs page
            d=re.search(r'\$\s*\$?\s*([\d,\s]*\d)',rec)
            v=int(re.sub(r'[,\s]','',d.group(1))) if d else 0
            c[v]+=1
            if not re.search(r'ticket\s*escalation',rec,re.I): print('notinrec',f)
print(tot,n,c.most_common())
E
python3 -I $TMPDIR/a.py
